Our work in Foundational/ Large Language Models (LLM)
Generative AI is a type of AI that creates new content or synthetic data based on what it has learned from a given dataset.
Medical or Healthcare large language models (LLMs) are advanced AI-powered systems designed to understand & process vast amount of medical text

They possess the ability to
Comprehend complex medical texts
Extract meaningful information
Generate valuable insights for healthcare professionals
Large Language Models (LLM) are a type of Deep Learning AI model notable for its ability to achieve general-purpose Language understanding and generation
LLMs are finding Applications in every Healthcare Segment

Diabetic Retinopathy Detection using Computer Vision

Diabetic Retinopathy is the leading cause of blindness in the working-age population of the developed world. It is estimated to affect over 93 million people
Need of expertise and equipment required to detect DR is very high and is often unavailable in areas where requirement is high.
Images are classified into four classes according to their retinopathy grades:
Input Images are processed using Image Processing techniques
ML techniques such as neural networks and classifiers are used
Successful classification into one of the four class

Results
Successful in predicting Retinopathy of severity grade 2 and 3 with more than 90% accuracy
If fundus images for both the eyes of the patient are available, the model will predict Retinopathy 2/3 with 99+ percent accuracy!
Automatically suggest appropriate ICD codes based on medical records of the patient

Eliminate audit and investigation of health care provider due to over-coding
Increases customer satisfaction by eliminating under-coding

Dear Dr 
Clinic notes 
Many thanks for referring this lady who last year was awoken at night by moderately fast regular palpitations which had a gradual offset. These symptoms have not recurred. She is otherwise well although is on treatment for hypertension. She stopped smoking 60 years ago and drinks rarely. Recent thyroid function tests have shown a slightly elevated TSH but a normal free thyroxine. Apart from amlodipine 5 mg daily, she takes simvastatin and calcium supplements. Her ECG showed sinus rhythm with a leftward axis. Ambulatory monitoring has shown sinus rhythm with first degree heart block at lower rates and two short salvos of atrial tachycardia of no more than 2 seconds. She was asymptomatic to these. I would pass her tape as within normal limits for the patient, and in the absence of ongoing symptoms would not suggest any specific treatment. I will arrange for an echocardiogram, however, and will write back further with the results. If she does suffer further palpitations, a small dose of bisoprolol such as 1.25 mg daily would be reasonable. With many thanks for your referral. 
Yours sincerely 
cc list Consultant

Patient Condition Prediction – Early Warning System

NEWS tends to give many false alarms
NEWS may not generate alarm until rapid deterioration is observed
Build predictive system, than detective system, based on physiological measurements of hospital inpatients

Clinical: Prediction of medical condition
Operation: Generation of timely alerts
Research: Patient segmentation based on the patterns observed/emerged

Scoring system pertaining to patient medical condition
Based on the physiological parameters such as BP, RR, PR, O2S and TEMP
Magnitude of score depends on variation in parameter from the norm
Alert is generated based on the rules applied to aggregated score
